description: Netherlands address-validation leg (BAG via PDOK Locatieserver, CC BY 4.0) at $0.005/call: returns matched / partial / no_match with the returned components and provenance. No confidence field. Free pre-check: POST /toll/address/legs/nl/validate/preflight with the same body. $0.005 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/address/legs/nl/validate.

address.description: Structured address components: street_number, street_name, locality, postcode required; unit, street_type, state optional.

name: address_leg_nl
